title: Someone Bet 13 Million That Tesla Rips 25% by April
speaker: tastylive host (Signal vs. Noise)

macro_themes.view: In a rising-rates environment markets tend to punish companies with rich valuations, thin margins and negative free cash flow, like Tesla.

calls.condition: If TSLA pushes through the ~390 swing highs / 395, it starts breaking the downtrend and the April 430-call buyer's path (breakeven 457.45) gets easier; if Roadster and Oct 21 earnings both miss, the position may be unwound.
calls.reason: $13.4M bought in April 2027 430 calls (122x prior open interest) as a relative-value catch-up bet on the only negative Mag 7 name; earnings implied move ~6.2% (339-384).
calls.quote: I want to see if we can poke through the recent swing highs here near 390... we're starting to break that downtrend.

notes: Host relays a bullish options-flow bet but his own view is conditional; the 457.45 breakeven is the flow buyer's, not a host target. Date from 'Roadster event tonight on October 15th'.
